answer: Require every agent to forge its identity by staking a walnut-sized, time-locked deposit that only matures after a history of useful work. New identities start with zero trust and must earn reputation through verified contributions, while a vine of cross-checks links the actions of each identity across independent ledgers, so duplicate personas are exposed when their histories overlap. Creating one fake costs a locked deposit plus weeks of work; creating a thousand costs a thousand deposits, with no bulk discount.
